title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Newly added standard extensions missing in upgraded environments (Uninstalled apps will now remain uninstalled)
summary: In Business Central 2026 release wave 1, newly added standard extensions like External Storage for Document Attachments are not automatically installed in upgraded environments due to a change where uninstalled apps remain uninstalled. Partners must manually install missing extensions using direct URLs or AppSource.
key_points: New standard extensions are not automatically installed during environment upgrades to BC28
Microsoft changed behavior so uninstalled apps remain uninstalled after upgrades
Missing extensions can be installed manually via direct URL using the extension's App ID
Standard extensions will be available on AppSource for one-click installation
